Garden tips

Keep it green.

Water early

Morning watering lets lawns and beds absorb moisture before the heat, and wastes less to evaporation.

Mow little and often

Cutting a small amount at a time keeps grass thick. Taking off too much at once weakens it.

Plant ahead of the rains

Nairobi has a long and a short rainy season. Planting shortly before them helps new plants settle in.
